newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Sun Fook Kong surges on stake sale talk.
newsitem.headline: Sun Fook Kong surges on stake sale talk.

text.p: Shares of Sun Fook Kong Holdings Ltd surged nearly 30 percent after trading resumed on Thursday, fuelled by talk that a China-backed firm would buy into the company, analysts said.
Shares in the construction and civil engineering group were up HK$0.31, or 27 percent, at HK$1.45 at midday.
The company said in a statement that its 51.6 percent controlling shareholders were in talks concerning the sale of part of their stake in the company and that a sale may lead to a general offer.
But it said discussions were at a preliminary stage and that no agreement had yet been reached.
"Market talk that China Travel is expected to buy into the company is giving the stock a boost today," said Patrick Chia, research director at China Everbright Research.
China Travel Service is a mainland tourism conglomerate with a local investment arm, China Travel International Investment Hong Kong Ltd, listed in Hong Kong.
